research.title: Evaluating Image Classifier Robustness to Background Changes
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare image classifiers under background replacement, using controlled foreground masks and consistent training splits.
Implemented evaluation pipelines in PyTorch and analyzed prediction changes across background conditions, documenting potential confounds from mask boundaries and object scale.

work.title: Image Ingestion Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented Python validation routines for uploaded images, checking file readability, channel consistency, and dimension constraints before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and maintained preprocessing components, investigating failures through application logs and reproducible test cases.

projects.title: Comparing Feature Representations for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented histogram of oriented gradients with a linear classifier and a convolutional baseline for classification on a shared image dataset.
Compared classification errors and sensitivity to translation using matched data splits, documenting preprocessing choices and differences between learned and handcrafted features.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented median filtering and a convolutional denoising autoencoder, applying identical synthetic corruption settings to paired clean and noisy images.
Evaluated reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, examining edge preservation and artifacts across corruption types.
